profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.summary: Experienced leader in Information Technology and full-stack software development with a demonstrated skill set in team leadership, software engineering, and server administration. Proficient in modern web and mobile technologies, large-language models and agentic flows, cloud hosting, relational and document database systems, API and REST connectivity, and the user experience. Strong business and interpersonal skills with a Master's degree in Business Administration.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Android Development · HTML5 · Large Language Models (LLM) · Prompt Engineering · Java · Database Administration · React.js · Server Administration · JavaScript · Web Development · Node.js · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: IT Director, Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managed all IT expertise, including software development, server administration, product management, and technical support. Directed the team that designed and developed a near-911 critical service for healthcare patients used by more than 10,000 individuals each week. Also established a micro-services environment for rapid development and maintainability for SAAS products. Personally designed and developed web and mobile software, interactive reports and alerts, many UI / UX interfaces, and administrated SQL and document database servers, etc.

Worked in many different technologies, including iOS/Android development, JavaScript, Java, HTML/CSS, Angular, C#, microservices, ASP.NET, MySQL, SQL Server, CouchDB, RabbitMQ, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Linux and Windows server environments, phone call routing, etc.

Served under multiple roles, including senior project and engineering leadership, software development, mobile app development, web graphics and layout design, server administration and planning, network engineering, DNS management, training, technical customer support, etc.

positions.title: Applications Development Team Lead
positions.description: Directed internal software development personnel and activities. Planned and developed key software systems as needed. Supplemented database management and maintenance. Continued to administrate over databases and database servers.

positions.title: Sr. Database Administrator
positions.description: Managed the company's databases as well as completed new database and desktop development. Decreased discovery time of critical database emergencies from hours to 30 seconds or less.

positions.title: Volunteer Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and developed student scheduling software in Java that aids in assigning students to
classes while accounting for various needs and constraints including gender, IEP status,
academic, and behavioral attributes. Donated said software to Davis School District, saving the district more than $20,000 yearly.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description: Co-developed the company's next generation flagship product. Designed and animated the product's unique graphical user interface.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Pioneered the Weber State University Career Services website content management system,
enabling nontechnical students to manage and update the site. Analyzed website needs and deficiencies and negotiated the execution of such to WSU
Career Services department leadership.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Operated as webmaster, developer, and support specialist for Utah Public Radio. Authored a fresh feed of daily news and web content for the radio station.

positions.title: Software Developer / Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Provided software development and technical support for the YETC computer lab. Assisted in instructing aspiring teachers on how to utilize computer and Internet technology
in their studies.

positions.title: CEO and Entrepreneur
positions.description: Operated a business serving the community in all things computer hardware and software. Contracted as a technical specialist for Morgan School District.
